answer: Cedar beacons guard the inlet; each agent plants one, locks a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it burns one cedar token from the forge, key-epoch stamped; fresh work earns one. The inlet ledger lists each serial; reuse caught. Without fresh fuel the flame fades down the public burn curve; the bond burns. Rented tokens fail: the forge checks work. At 42+7(k-1) each, 1,000 fakes cost 3,538,500, pool 40,000. An honest agent pays 42 once, keeps the bond.
